# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Canonical record of one invocation whose diagnostics are compared by class
# (pane 214). Usage: errclass.py LABEL STATUS OUT ERR [WORD...]
# Prints "LABEL status=S stdout=<repr> stderr=CLASSES" where CLASSES lists,
# per stderr line in order, the errno name whose C-library strerror text the
# line contains (longest match; "text" when none) plus "/WORD" for the
# longest WORD the rest of the line contains (the strerror text removed). Raw streams go to observations.txt; OUT and
# ERR are removed. Used for parity where wording differs by design.
import errno, os, pathlib, sys

label, status, out, err = sys.argv[1:5]
words = sorted(sys.argv[5:], key=len, reverse=True)
texts = sorted(((os.strerror(code), name) for code, name in errno.errorcode.items()), key=lambda t: -len(t[0]))
stdout = pathlib.Path(out).read_bytes()
stderr = pathlib.Path(err).read_bytes()
classes = []
for line in stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace').splitlines():
    match = next(((text, n) for text, n in texts if text in line), ('', 'text'))
    name, rest = match[1], line.replace(match[0], '', 1) if match[0] else line
    word = next((w for w in words if w in rest), None)
    classes.append(name + ('/' + word if word else ''))
with open('observations.txt', 'a') as log:
    log.write('[%s] status %s\nstdout %r\nstderr %r\n' % (label, status, stdout, stderr))
os.unlink(out)
os.unlink(err)
print('%s status=%s stdout=%r stderr=%s' % (label, status, stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace'), ','.join(classes) or 'empty'))

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Trusted namespace builder for storage fixtures (pane 214): runs as uid 0 of
# a fresh user+mount namespace (unshare --user --map-root-user --mount),
# mounts a private tmpfs of SIZE at DIR with mount(2), checks its block count
# with statvfs(2), then executes the remaining argv inside that namespace.
# Usage: storage_ns.py DIR SIZE PROGRAM [ARG...]
import ctypes, os, sys

directory, size, program = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3:]
assert os.geteuid() == 0, 'storage_ns.py must run as user-namespace root'
lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
if lib.mount(b'parity-small', directory.encode(), b'tmpfs', ctypes.c_ulong(0),
             ('size=%s,mode=0755' % size).encode()) != 0:
    print('SETUP-INVALID mount tmpfs: %s' % os.strerror(ctypes.get_errno()))
    sys.exit(97)
info = os.statvfs(directory)
if info.f_blocks * info.f_frsize != int(size):
    print('SETUP-INVALID tmpfs size %d' % (info.f_blocks * info.f_frsize))
    sys.exit(97)
os.execv(program[0], program)

# streams are appended to observations.txt, then OUT and ERR are removed.
import os, pathlib, sys

label, status, out, err = sys.argv[1:5]
needles = sys.argv[5:]
stdout = pathlib.Path(out).read_bytes()
stderr = pathlib.Path(err).read_bytes()
text = stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
if not stderr:
    shown = 'empty'
elif needles and all(n in text for n in needles):
    shown = 'has:' + '|'.join(needles)
elif not needles:
    shown = 'nonempty'
else:
    shown = repr(text)
with open('observations.txt', 'a') as log:
    log.write('[%s] status %s\nstdout %r\nstderr %r\n' % (label, status, stdout, stderr))
os.unlink(out)
os.unlink(err)
print('%s status=%s stdout=%r stderr=%s' % (label, status, stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace'), shown))
